title: SHEETH, the wallet  condom
tagline: A condom for your wallet. SHEETH automatically intercepts your transactions and creates burner wallets to interact with contracts on your behalf. This security layer helps keep your tokens in your main wallets safe from malicious code.

prizes.placement: ⚡️Tenderly — Use the full power of Tenderly
prizes.title: Tenderly

description:
There's a huge problem of people ape-ing into unverified unaudited smart contracts and getting rugged. SHEETH provision burner wallets for each new dapp you use. These burner wallets carry out the original transaction you were intending to do, then transfer back minted NFTs as well as any leftover ETH dust.

This whole process takes place automatically — you can just stay on your main wallet the entire time and use dapps/contracts normally. SHEETH waits for contract interaction transactions and then intercepts them in the background. Additionally, by keeping track of burner wallets used, we also ensure that you don’t lose out on any airdrops associated with usage of those dapps.
